subject: Arcadia Health trial handoff + integration playbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Bryan Cole <bryan@arcadiahealth.com>, Sarah Gupta <sarah.gupta@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia Health trial handoff + integration playbook

Hi Bryan / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps to get the 4-week trial moving and validate your success criteria. I captured things as we discussed; please flag anything I missed.

What we heard (success criteria):
- Precision target: intent extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the annotated validation set you shared.
- Latency: median 95th-token latency < 220ms for chat/assistant flows in your us-west region.
- Cost: token spend < $1.2 per 1k user sessions for the trial workload (with our suggested batching/caching).
- Integrations: demo of streaming assistant with tool-calls to your scheduling API and a working embedding-based document search.

Proposed evaluation plan + timeline (quick):
- Week 0 (this week): sign SOW & approve trial credentials (I attached the SOW draft).
- Week 1: SDK integration + routing: Arcadia devs wire SDK + test generate/chat routes in sandbox; Redwood provides sample snippets and a pre-seeded dataset.
- Week 2: Streaming + tool-calls: enable streaming assistant, test tool-calls (POST webhook to your /api/schedule).
- Week 3: Acceptance run: run annotated validation, collect latency/cost metrics, iterate prompts.
- Week 4: Wrap & decision: acceptance signoff / next-steps (Dedicated or Hosted contract).

Ownership (Redwood / Arcadia):
- Redwood: Jon (me) — commercial/coordination; Marissa (CS) — trial success & eval; Ben (Solutions) — API/SDK integration and initial routing; Soojin (Infra eng) — streaming & KV-cache tuning.
- Arcadia: Bryan (product owner), Sarah (tech lead), plus a point in procurement for SOW.

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Please confirm the acceptance criteria above (or send edits).
2) Share the dev sandbox email for API creds (or confirm if you want us to provision).
3) Procurement contact + preferred timeline to sign SOW (I attached a draft).

Attachments included: arcadia-poc-sow.pdf, redwood-sdk-integration-guide.md (SDK quickstarts and routes).

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Marissa/Ben/Soojin for Monday morning PT unless you prefer another slot.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Bryan Cole <bryan@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Gupta <sarah.gupta@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arcadia Health trial handoff + integration playbook

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of clarifications before we lock the kickoff: 

1) SDK / API surface: can you confirm the exact endpoints we should exercise in week 1 vs week 2? Specifically: will embeddings + simple generate be enough in week 1, or do you expect us to wire streaming endpoints immediately?

2) Tool-calls: our scheduling endpoint requires mutual TLS for /api/schedule in sandbox. Is Redwood able to call back via mTLS, or should we proxy via our gateway?

3) Data residency & logging: our security team will want to confirm logs retention and that PII is redacted before it hits Redwood logs during the trial. We can provide an NDA + brief questionnaire if needed.

Procurement: looping procurement@arcadiahealth.com on SOW questions. We aim to sign by next Thursday if the technical path is clear.

Thanks —
Bryan
Product Lead, Arcadia Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Arcadia Health trial handoff + integration playbook (internal tasking)

Internal thread — assigning owners and immediate next steps based on Bryan's questions.

Ben: own the week-1 SDK checklist and provide a minimal test plan (endpoints, sample payloads). Deliverable: SDK test matrix + sample curl/node/python snippets by EOD Wed 9/8. Focus: embeddings.generate, text.generate, chat.stream (non-stream fallback).

Soojin: evaluate mTLS options for tool-call webhook. If Redwood cannot do mTLS outbound from managed runtime, plan B is to document proxy instructions for Arcadia gateway (we should provide a sample proxy container or webhook relay). Deliverable: recommendation + sample proxy by Thu 9/9.

Jonas: handle procurement/SOW negotiations and confirm redwood logging/retention policy for the trial. I will draft the security note for Bryan's team around PII redaction and retention.

Also — prepare a small acceptance checklist for week 3 that the CS team can run (prompt set, annotated eval, latency runbook). I'll own the acceptance checklist.

Thanks team. We'll sync 30m tomorrow after Ben's artifacts land.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Bryan Cole <bryan@arcadiahealth.com>, Sarah Gupta <sarah.gupta@arcadiahealth.com>, procurement@arcadiahealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia trial kickoff confirmed — timeline + developer checklist

Bryan / Sarah / procurement — thanks for the quick replies. Below is an updated, actionable plan and the specific API/SDK items we suggest you exercise in the first two weeks. Please review and confirm and we'll calendar the kickoff.

Confirmed timeline (dates are target):
- 09/09 — Redwood provides SDK test matrix & proxy sample (Ben + Soojin deliverables).
- 09/10 — Kickoff call (30m) to walk how-to and sandbox creds.
- 09/11–09/17 — Week 1: integrate SDK routes, validate embeddings and basic generate flows.
- 09/18–09/24 — Week 2: enable streaming assistant + tool-call tests (scheduling webhook).
- 09/25–09/30 — Week 3: annotated acceptance runs, latency/cost measurement.
- 10/01 — Decision checkpoint and next-contract conversation.

Developer checklist (essential endpoints + examples):
- embeddings.create (POST /v1/embeddings): ingest a sample docs set and verify vector search results.
- responses.generate (POST /v1/responses): single-request text generation for prompt iteration.
- chat.stream (POST /v1/chat/stream): long-lived stream for assistant responses. Fallback: chat.complete non-stream.
- tool-calls (webhook flow): Redwood will send POST to your webhook. Endpoint patterns we will call during the trial:
   - /api/schedule (expects JSON {"user_id":...,"slot":...})
   - /api/lookup (optional lookup calls for reference data)

Security and networking notes:
- mTLS: Soojin evaluated options; we can support https webhook callbacks from Redwood if Arcadia exposes a TLS endpoint behind a gateway. Redwood managed runtime does not currently originate mutual TLS client certs from the hosted pool. Plan B: Arcadia runs a lightweight webhook relay (we will provide a sample container) that handles mTLS to your internal endpoint and accepts Redwood callbacks over standard HTTPS.
- Logging/PII: Redwood retains trial logs for 30 days by default. We will enable prompt-level redaction on your trial key and can configure additional retention settings if needed. Marissa will send the security note and a short SOC2/retention excerpt for your security team.

Attachments (again):
- arcadia-poc-sow.pdf — SOW with trial length and commercial terms.
- redwood-sdk-integration-guide.md — SDK snippets and the test matrix Ben will expand on.

Next steps for Arcadia team (please reply):
1) Confirm you can host a reachable HTTPS endpoint for callbacks or confirm you want the sample relay.
2) Confirm procurement timeline; we'll mark 09/16 as our contract-signing target to keep the schedule.
3) Pick a kickoff time on 09/10 09:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–16:00 PT — we can accommodate either.

If all good I'll send calendar invites and a short runbook for the kickoff. Looking forward.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
